title: TeD-Loc: Text Distillation for Weakly Supervised Object Localization
abstract: arXiv:2501.12632v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Weakly supervised object localization (WSOL) models can predict both the object class and the spatial regions corresponding to the object, without requiring explicit bounding-box annotations. Given their reliance on classification objectives, traditional WSOL methods, like class activation mapping, tend to focus on the most discriminative object regions, often missing the full spatial extent. Although vision-language models like CLIP encode rich semantic priors, their global text and class-token embeddings are not explicitly aligned with local patch embeddings, limiting patch-level localization. Recent methods such as GenPrompt address this limitation, but at the cost of increased complexity, as they rely on conditional denoising and elaborate prompt-learning strategies. In this paper, we propose Text Distillation for Localization (TeD-Loc), which distills knowledge from CLIP text embeddings to patch embeddings through contrast

translated_title: TeD-Loc：面向弱监督目标定位的文本蒸馏
translated_abstract: 弱监督目标定位（WSOL）模型能够在无需显式边界框标注的情况下，同时预测目标的类别及其对应的空间区域。由于依赖于分类目标，传统的WSOL方法（如类激活映射）往往只关注目标最具判别性的区域，常常遗漏目标完整的空间范围。尽管CLIP等视觉-语言模型编码了丰富的语义先验，但其全局的文本嵌入和类别词元嵌入并未与局部图像块（patch）嵌入显式对齐，从而限制了patch级别的定位能力。诸如GenPrompt等近期方法虽然解决了这一局限，但代价是复杂度增加，因为它们依赖条件去噪和复杂的提示学习策略。在本文中，我们提出了面向定位的文本蒸馏方法TeD-Loc，该方法通过对比（学习）将CLIP文本嵌入中的知识蒸馏到patch嵌入中……
tldr: TeD-Loc通过对比学习将CLIP文本嵌入的知识蒸馏到patch嵌入中，在不引入条件去噪和复杂提示学习等额外机制的情况下，实现更完整、更精准的弱监督目标定位。
en_tdlr: TeD-Loc distills knowledge from CLIP text embeddings into patch embeddings via contrastive learning, achieving more complete and accurate weakly supervised object localization without the added complexity of conditional denoising or elaborate prompt learning.
